description: Function generator with four models in one panel: the tidal modulator, a sixteen-voice harmonic oscillator, a duophonic random walk generator and a wavetable scanner, with a quantiser on the pitch

params.text: Advances the mode on each press; what the three modes are follows the model: AD, cyclic and AR envelopes, which harmonics ring, how the clocks start, or the wave bank
Advances the frequency range on each press: high after medium, low after high, then medium again; with the harmonic oscillator chosen it sets sine quality rather than range
Chooses the model: tidal modulator, two bumps, two drunks or Sheep; the display beside it shows T, B, D or S
Sets the rate, four octaves either side of centre; with the random walk model it sets the rate of the main clock, and while clock sync is on it sets the ratio between the clock and the output
Attenuverts the FM input, 5V shifting the pitch by an octave at full clockwise; with the random walk model it also sets the width of the output gates
Sets the curvature of the rise and fall; with the harmonic oscillator it picks the first centre frequency, with the random walk the interpolation between steps, and with Sheep the X coordinate
Sets the split between rise and fall; with the harmonic oscillator it picks the second centre frequency, with the random walk the two clocks' delay and probability, and with Sheep the Y coordinate
Low-pass filters the wave counter-clockwise of noon and wavefolds it clockwise; with the harmonic oscillator it sets how many harmonics ring, and with the random walk the largest step
Locks the generator to the CLOCK input while it is on
Switches the built-in quantiser on and picks its scale from semitones, major, minor, whole tones, pentatonic minor, poor pentatonic and fifths; the three lamps beside it show the choice in binary

inputs.text: Adds to the SHAPE knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
Adds to the SLOPE knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
Adds to the SMOOTH knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
A voltage of 0.7V or more starts the envelope or resets the cycle; with the harmonic oscillator it randomises the phase of every harmonic, and with the random walk it starts the clocks
A voltage of 0.7V or more stops the wave where it is until the voltage falls again; with the harmonic oscillator each gate instead permutes the harmonics sent to the UNI output
Sets the rate, one volt per octave, quantised to the scale the QNTZ knob selects
Shifts the rate through the FM attenuverter; with nothing patched it reads a constant 0.1V
Scales the UNI and BI outputs like a VCA, 8V giving full level and higher voltages clipped; with nothing patched it reads 8V
Synchronises the generator to this signal while clock sync is on, reading high at 0.7V; with clock sync off, edges here randomise the harmonic oscillator's settings or the random walk's range

outputs.text: Carries 5V once the rising segment has finished; with the harmonic oscillator it carries a one-bit version of the BI output, and with the random walk the clock of channel 1
Carries 5V once the falling segment has finished; with the harmonic oscillator it carries a square sub-oscillator an octave down, and with the random walk the clock of channel 2
The wave as a unipolar signal, 0-8V; with the harmonic oscillator it carries the permuted harmonics, and with the random walk the walk of channel 1
The wave as a bipolar signal, -5V to 5V, with a positive and a negative bump in each cycle; with the harmonic oscillator it is that model's main output, and with the random walk the walk of channel 2

notes: the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes a single channel.
clock sync is engaged by the SYNC button alone, unlike Aestus, where patching a cable to CLOCK engages it as well.
with the random walk model the SHAPE, SLOPE and SMOOTH knobs are read inverted for channel 2, so the two channels agree only with the knob centred.
menu: Model: Tidal Modulator, Two Bumps - Harmonic oscillator, Two Drunks - Random walk, Sheep - Wavetable synthesizer — chooses the model the module runs
Mode: AD Envelope, Cyclic, AR Envelope — sets what the tidal modulator does, and appears only with that model
Harmonics: Odd, First 16, Octaves — picks which harmonics ring, and appears only with the harmonic oscillator model
Mode: Trigger, Cycling, Gate — sets how the random walk clocks are started, and appears only with that model
Wave table: Additive harmonics, PWMish, Nodi WMAP — picks the bank of waves the Sheep model scans, and appears only with that model
Frequency range: High, Medium, Low — sets the frequency range
Sine quality: High, Medium, Low — sets how finely the sine waves are interpolated, and replaces the frequency range entry with the harmonic oscillator model
Quantizer scale: Off, Semitones, Major, Minor, Whole tones, Pentatonic Minor, Poor pentatonic, Fifths — picks the scale the pitch is quantised to
Compatibility options — the submenu holding the settings that restore how older versions of the module behaved
Frequency knob center is C4 — subtracts a volt from the pitch so a centred FREQUENCY knob gives C4; switching it off restores the older tuning. It is on the Compatibility options submenu
